name: City Pitties
neighborhoods: Bay Ridge, Brooklyn-based; affiliated with 19 rescues across all 5 boroughs + NJ/CT/LI
notes: NYC-based bully-breed foster and advocacy network (Bay Ridge, Brooklyn), affiliated with 19 shelters/rescues across all five boroughs, Central NJ, CT, and Long Island. Focuses on the American Pit Bull Terrier, pit mixes, and other bully breeds (incl. American Bulldogs, American Bull Terriers); connects them with tri-state foster homes (min about 3 weeks, breed experience requested) and adopters. Advocates on NYCHA breed/weight rules. Also a resource hub for bully owners and rescues. Phone: (no public phone; email/app) Email: (application via site) Intake: home + reference check required
